headline: IRGC Quds Force chief Esmail Qaani says regional resistance-front leaders pledged written allegiance to Khamenei
dek: Quds Force commander Esmail Qaani says leaders of the regional 'resistance front' pledged their allegiance to Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei, declaring 'their full loyalty in writing' and showing 'that the commanders had received and implemented the message at the highest level', per ISNA as…
sources: ISNA (Iranian Students' News Agency), via Al Jazeera liveblog
fault_line: A unified resistance front ready for unrestricted war vs. rhetoric masking a deterred Iran after the midterm rebuke

sections.what_happened: Quds Force commander Esmail Qaani says leaders of the regional 'resistance front' pledged their allegiance to Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei, declaring 'their full loyalty in writing' and showing 'that the commanders had received and implemented the message at the highest level', per ISNA as quoted by Al Jazeera. The remarks follow Khamenei's Nov 4 broader-retaliation warning (1600-01).
sections.what_verified: Al Jazeera liveblog quoting ISNA (1 countable family; ISNA has NO declared tier in the registry and does not count). Social echo, not independent corroboration: Al Mayadeen IG post 2026-11-04 12:18 UTC (16:18 , in-window) carried the same Qaani/Khamenei message as a graphic (220 likes, 3 comments); Al Mayadeen is unlisted in the registry and sits in the same pro-resistance media ecosystem.
sections.what_disputed: No independent confirmation of any written pledges; no pledging leader named in the AJ entry; no US/Israeli response in-window.
sections.why_matters: Follow-on beat to the Khamenei broader-retaliation lead (1600-01), not a standalone lead: Tehran stages visible unity hours after the warning. Usable as a second beat inside a Khamenei-warning Short; the statement alone is too thin to lead.
sections.context: Background: IN-WINDOW (AJ liveblog 12:15 GMT = 16:15 ): IRGC Quds Force chief Esmail Qaani says regional resistance-front leaders pledged written allegiance to Khamenei

totw_analysis: Our read: Follow-on beat to the Khamenei broader-retaliation lead (1600-01), not a standalone lead: Tehran stages visible unity hours after the warning. Usable as a second beat inside a Khamenei-warning Short; the statement alone is too thin to lead. The fault line our audience is arguing over: A unified resistance front ready for unrestricted war vs. rhetoric masking a deterred Iran after the midterm rebuke
